answer: A burn registry makes every identity pay to exist. A joining agent burns 250 POA to a public address keyed to its pubkey, and the receipt becomes its ticket. A sybil operator who wants 2,000 clones spends 500,000 POA before the first clone can vote, and every burn sits visible on the ledger, so the cluster exposes itself early. The supply never returns, which turns scale into a tax the attacker pays and the network keeps. The vertex of control then spreads thin as a plume of smoke across the tundra of real accounts.
